name: aaina
description: Professional on-model product photos from one photo of a product, for online sellers.

interface.longDescription:
Aaina is a product photo studio for online sellers. Share one photo of your product (clothing and ethnic wear such as kurtas, sarees and lehengas, jewellery, bags, shoes or accessories) and Aaina shows it worn or held by a realistic studio model, in poses and scenes that suit the product, ready for listings on marketplaces and your own shop.

What you can do in ChatGPT:
- Tag @Aaina, attach a product photo and ask for model photos. The Aaina card reads the product and suggests models, poses and scenes; you can name a model or scene yourself (for example "on Aaina in a white studio").
- Check the choices on the card, then press Make. Photos are made only when you press Make.
- Watch the photos arrive, download them, or open the shoot in Aaina for marketplace sizes.
- Ask to see your photos: the Your photos tab shows the photos you made with Aaina on the website or in ChatGPT, newest first, ready to download.
- Ask which poses or scenes suit your product.

Who it's for: sellers and brands who need consistent catalogue photos without a photoshoot.

Good to know:
- You need an Aaina account (sign in or create one when you connect).
- Studio models are fictional people created for Aaina. Aaina works from product photos only: it doesn't edit photos of real people, and in ChatGPT it offers adult models only.
- Each photo takes about a minute.
defaultPrompt: Put this T-shirt on a model in a white studio for my Amazon listing
Show my kurta on a model in an outdoor scene
Which poses suit this dress for my Myntra photos?

positive.description: A seller attaches a product photo and asks for model photos: the Aaina card opens with the product read from the photo, suggested models, poses, a scene and a Make button. Nothing is made.
positive.prompt: @Aaina put this T-shirt on a model for my Amazon listing
positive.expected_behavior: The Aaina card shows the T-shirt, a model, suggested T-shirt poses (four chosen), White Studio chosen and a 'Make 4 photos' button. ChatGPT says the user can review the choices and press Make; no photos are made.

positive.description: The seller names the model and the scene: the card opens with those chosen.
positive.prompt: @Aaina put this T-shirt on Aaina in a white studio
positive.expected_behavior: The card opens with the model Aaina and the White Studio scene chosen, and ChatGPT confirms both. Nothing is made until Make is pressed.

positive.description: The seller asks for an outdoor scene by name: the card opens with that scene chosen, and a name that isn't exact still finds it.
positive.prompt: @Aaina put this T-shirt on a model in Big Sur
positive.expected_behavior: The card opens with the Big Sur scene chosen and suggested poses for the T-shirt; ChatGPT confirms the scene and says the user can press Make. Nothing is made until Make is pressed.

positive.description: The seller presses Make on the card for one photo, then asks about the photoshoot.
positive.expected_behavior: After a photo was made from the card (press Make with one pose chosen), the card shows 'Making your photos' and then the finished photo with Download; asked in chat, ChatGPT reports how many photos are ready.

positive.description: The seller asks to see the photos made with Aaina before.
positive.expected_behavior: The Aaina card opens on the Your photos tab with the account's photos, newest first and grouped by product, each with a download button and an Open in Aaina link. Nothing is made.

negative.description: General image generation that isn't a product photo: Aaina should not be used.
negative.prompt: Draw a cat astronaut on the moon

negative.description: Writing text, not photos: Aaina should not be used.
negative.prompt: Write a product description for my cotton kurta

negative.description: Buying credits: Aaina has no purchase tool and should not act.

review.commerce_description: No commerce in ChatGPT. Users sign in to their existing Aaina account and use credits already in it; nothing is sold, priced as a plan, or linked for purchase inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: on-model product photos from a product photo, with Aaina's studio models, poses and scenes.
